SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 2, Special Branch
REPORT
File No. C.I.L. POLICE
REGISTRY
D. 7407
23 / 5
Date May 22 1936
Subject Tsang Tsoong Sing, Korean, information requested by Japanese
Consular Police.
Made by D.P.S. Henchmen Forwarded by
Enquiries made at the Yangtze Hotel, Hankow Road, with
reference to a Korean, Chang Tsoong Sing, have elicited the
information that a Korean named Tsang Tsoong Sing (Chinese
pronounciation 張忠信) stayed at the hotel on two separate
occasions during the early part of this year; on both occasions
he shared his room with another Korean called Mao Tseng Ping
(毛振斌).
On his first visit Tsang occupied Room No. 312 and shared
it with Mao, they both arrived on 20th January and left, having
settled their account, on 31st January. Although they both
described themselves as merchants neither appeared to have
any business.
On 5th March both Tsang and Mao again visited the Yangtze
Hotel where for the first day they occupied Room No. 336 and
then moved to No. 325, which room they occupied until 4th
April when they both absconded without settling their bill of
$230. They did not take their baggage with them but left
three suitcases behind; one suitcase is locked and according
to the management, has not been opened, the other two cases
contain old clothes and Japanese books, these suitcases are
still at the hotel. During their last stay at the hotel
they made several attempts to obtain money and on three or
four occasions they sent telegrams in the name of Feng Shiao
Tsin (馮曉秋), address Sing Tuh Shing (新德兴) Lodging House,
corner of Rue Pere Proc and Rue Amiral Bayle, to one Tsang
Zung Yih (張成一), East Asia Trading Co., Hsin Hwa Ka, Tientsin,
with requests that money should be sent to the above address
in the French Concession, but so far as could be ascertained
no money was received.

日期 1936年5月22日
事由 朝鲜人张忠信（Tsang Tsoong Sing），日本领事馆警察 requested 信息。
制作人 D.P.S. 线人 转发人
就一名叫 Chang Tsoong Sing 的朝鲜人向汉口路扬子饭店进行的查询，获得了如下信息：一名叫张忠信（Tsang Tsoong Sing，中文发音）的朝鲜人于今年年初两次入住该饭店；在这两次期间，他都与另一名名叫毛振斌（Mao Tseng Ping）的朝鲜人合住一间客房。
第一次入住时，张住在312号房间，与毛合住，两人均于1月20日抵达，并于1月31日结清账目后离开。虽然两人都自称是商人，但似乎并未从事任何商业活动。
3月5日，张和毛再次光顾扬子饭店，第一天他们住在336号房间，随后搬至325号房间，一直住到4月4日，两人未结清230美元的账单便潜逃。他们未带走行李，留下了三个手提箱；其中一个手提箱已上锁，据管理层称未曾打开，另外两个箱子装有旧衣服和日文书籍，这些手提箱至今仍留在饭店。在他们最后一次入住饭店期间，他们多次试图获取资金，并曾三四次以冯晓秋（Feng Shiao Tsin）的名义，从法租界贝勒路（Rue Amiral Bayle）与神父路（Rue Pere Proc）转角处的新德兴（Sing Tuh Shing）客栈，向天津新华街（Hsin Hwa Ka）东亚贸易公司（East Asia Trading Co.）的张成一（Tsang Zung Yih）发送电报，要求将钱款汇至上述法租界地址，但据查并未收到任何钱款。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. 2. Special Branch Station,
REPORT
Date...May 19,......19 36.

Subject...Police assistance requested by the Japanese Consular Police.

Made by...D. S. Kamashita.........Forwarded by...

The local Japanese Consular Police request the
Municipal Police to furnish some information regarding the
following matters :-
(1) If it is a fact that a Korean named Chang Tsoong Sing
(張忠信)(Chinese pronunciation), aged about 30,
put up at the Wangtsze Hotel(楊子飯店) in the
Settlement between January 20 and the middle part of
February of this year.
(2) If it is a fact that the Korean was admitted to or
visited the Paulun Hospital(宝隆医院), Burkill Road,
for treatment between February 18 and the end of
March of this year.
If it is possible, the local Japanese Consular Police
wish to have further information regarding the movements of
this Korean during the aforementioned period.
According to information received by the Japanese
Consular Police from Mukden Chang is wanted for a murder
committed in Tsinan(濟南).

D. Kamashita.
D. S.

Officer i/c, Special Branch.

事由...日本领事馆警察请求警务协助。

制作人...滨下（Kamashita）副督察.........转发人...

当地日本领事馆警察请求工部局警务处提供有关以下事项的一些信息：
(1) 一名叫张忠信（Chang Tsoong Sing）（中文发音）、年龄约30岁的朝鲜人，是否确实于今年1月20日至2月中旬期间入住过租界内的扬子饭店（Wangtsze Hotel）。
(2) 该朝鲜人是否确实于今年2月18日至3月底期间进入或前往伯基尔路（Burkill Road）的宝隆医院（Paulun Hospital）接受治疗。
如果可能，当地日本领事馆警察希望获得有关该朝鲜人在上述期间行踪的进一步信息。
根据日本领事馆警察从沈阳收到的信息，张因在济南（Tsinan）犯下谋杀案而被通缉。

D. Kamashita.
副督察。

特科主管警官。

Subject......Comment on article of the Harbin "Nash Put" regarding
activities of the Comintern in Shanghai.
Made by D. S. I. Prokofiev Forwarded by L J J Payne

Attached herewith is a translation of article entitled
"COMINTERN ESTABLISHED 'THE FIFTH BUREAU' IN SHANGHAI, " which
appeared in the "NASH PUT," a Russian daily published in Harbin,
on May 8, 1936.
The "NASH PUT" is the main organ of the so-called "All-
Russia Fascist Party" the headquarters of which are in Harbin.
It is reported that the Japanese authorities in Manchuria
have been according moral and material support to this party
and that, apart from the military group of Ataman Semenoff,
it is the only Russian political party which can openly function
in that country. Consequently, the newspaper in question is
of a strongly pro-Japanese character. It also has been
devoting much space to a violent anti-Semitic and anti-masonic
propaganda.
Articles bearing on the situation in Shanghai appear in
the "NASH PUT" from time to time. One of the main features
of these articles is the absolutely irresponsible character of
information they contain. The attached article is typical in
this respect. Reprinting the part of the article in question
referring to the Russian Regiment, S.V.C., the "NOVY PUT",
organ of the Shanghai branch of the Mladorossy Party, comments
as follows:
"It is with a feeling of profound indignation that we
reprint an extract from an article of the "Nash Put" containing
slanderous allegations regarding the Russian Regiment, S.V.C.,
the pride of Russian Shanghai. We do so only in order to show
that we have been right in denouncing the unsavoury activities
of the 'Nash Put' and its followers...... Thus, the Harbin
'fascisti' stretch out their dirty hands in an endeavour to......
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C.I.D. 10 MAY 1936）

事由......关于哈尔滨《我们的道路》（Nash Put）刊登的共产国际在上海活动文章的评论。
制作人 I. Prokofiev 副督察 转发人 L J J Payne

随函附上题为《共产国际在上海设立“第五局”》的文章译文，该文发表于1936年5月8日哈尔滨出版的俄文日报《我们的道路》（NASH PUT）。
《我们的道路》是所谓的“全俄法西斯党”的主要机关报，其总部设在哈尔滨。据报道，满洲的日本当局一直在给予该党精神和物质上的支持，并且，除了谢苗诺夫（Semenoff）阿塔曼的军事集团外，它是唯一能在该国公开活动的俄罗斯政党。因此，该报具有强烈的亲日性质。它还大量刊登激烈的反犹太主义和反共济会宣传。
《我们的道路》不时刊登有关上海局势的文章。这些文章的主要特点之一是其所载信息完全不负责任。所附文章在这方面具有代表性。《新路》（NOVY PUT，青年俄罗斯党上海分支的机关报）在转载有关俄罗斯团（S.V.C.）的文章部分时，评论如下：
“我们怀着深深的愤慨之情，转载《我们的道路》一文中包含的对俄罗斯团（S.V.C.，上海俄罗斯人的骄傲）进行诽谤性指控的摘录。我们这样做只是为了表明，我们谴责‘我们的道路’及其追随者的卑劣活动是正确的……因此，哈尔滨的‘法西斯分子’伸出脏手，企图用污泥……
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 刑事侦缉处 1936年5月10日）

page_data.en:
Translation from the "NASH PUT" (Russian daily newspaper
published in Harbin), dated May 8, 1936.

KOMINTERN ESTABLISHED THE "FIFTH BUREAU" IN SHANGHAI.

Firms camouflaging red subversive activities.-Fostering
trouble on the Philippine Islands and in China. -
Disintegration of Emigrants is the problem of the day. -
Sad news regarding Volunteer Detachment.
- - -

At the time when Stalin takes every opportunity of
denying in his declarations the existence of any connection
between the red Kremlin and subversive activities of the
Komintern directed towards the preparation of a world
revolution, information has been received from Shanghai
which gives a clear idea of the complete and close co-
operation between the Soviet Consulate and Komintern. This
information once more tears the mask off the face of Moscow
hypocrites.

It has been positively established, writes our
correspondent, that a new centre of the Komintern is at
present very active in Shanghai. It is the so-called
"FIFTH BUREAU OF THE KOMINTERN", which is one of the organs
in Asia
directing the world revolution.

The "Fifth Bureau of the Komintern" receives and
distributes funds allotted by the Soviet Consulate-General
for the purpose of supporting communist organizations,
uprisings, strikes; for subsidies to the press; for
providing local communist organizations with propaganda
literature, arms, explosives, etc.

The Bureau includes the following sections:-
1) Foreign Relations Section which maintains connections
with local communist organisations, in particular, with the
Chinese Communist Party.
2) Propaganda and Agitation Section which is engaged in
active work and prepares instructions. This section works
independently of local communist organisations and is known
under the name of The "Eastern Secretariat of Propaganda."
page_data.zh:
译自《我们的道路》（NASH PUT）（哈尔滨出版的俄文日报），日期为1936年5月8日。

共产国际在上海设立“第五局”。

伪装红色颠覆活动的公司。- 在菲律宾群岛和中国制造麻烦。-
瓦解移民是当务之急。-
关于志愿支队的坏消息。
- - -

正当斯大林在其声明中抓住一切机会否认红色克里姆林宫与旨在准备世界革命的共产国际颠覆活动之间存在任何联系之时，来自上海的消息清晰地揭示了苏联领事馆与共产国际之间全面而密切的合作。这一消息再次撕下了莫斯科伪君子的面具。

我们的记者写道，可以肯定的是，共产国际的一个新中心目前在上海非常活跃。这就是所谓的“共产国际第五局”，它是亚洲
指导世界革命的机构之一。

“共产国际第五局”接收并分配由苏联总领事馆拨付的资金，用于支持共产主义组织、起义、罢工；资助报刊；为当地共产主义组织提供宣传文献、武器、炸药等。

该局包括以下部门：
1) 对外关系处，负责与当地共产主义组织保持联系，特别是与中国共产党保持联系。
2) 宣传鼓动处，从事积极工作并制定指示。该处独立于当地共产主义组织运作，以“东方宣传秘书处”之名为人所知。

page_data.en:
-2-
The whole work of the Fifth Bureau is camouflaged under
the cover of various commercial firms and institutions such
as Dalbank, Moscow Bank, Trade Mission, Sovtorgflot, United
Petroleum Trust, Filipino Tobacco Company - which in reality
are organs of the Komintern.
Thanks to the presence of these institutions of the
Komintern the subversive activities of Soviet agents are
well organized and the results of these activities are
already noticeable.
We see how the red armies operating in the rear of
Nanking troops are supported directly from Shanghai.
The Filipino Tobacco Company is engaged, under the
cover of commercial pursuits, in facilitating communist
activities in the Philippine Islands. The recent disturbances
on the Bohol (?) Island (not far from Manila) is a result
of "Commercial" activities of this firm.
Especially active and well organized is the work among
the Chinese population in Shanghai. Demonstrations of
students and workers are frequent here. So many people
participate in such demonstrations sometimes that traffic
on Nanking Road is blocked. The participants distribute
communist leaflets and smash foreign concerns.
All traces of red activities invisibly lead to the
house in the Astor Road where the Soviet consulate is
situated, to comrade Bogolepoff, the local director of
preparations for the world revolution.
At present the immediate task of Soviet agents is,
according to instructions from Moscow, disintegration of White
Russian emigrants. For this purpose every means, every
possibility and all connections are utilized. The corrupt
press of the Mladorossy is at the disposal of Soviet agents.
Members of the Mladorossy party, such as Kazarsky, Dronov,
are closely connected with the "Eastern Secretariat of
Propaganda". The Mladorossy press has a disintegrating
effect on the morals of emigres.
The Russian Volunteer Detachment, owing to negligence
page_data.zh:
-2-
第五局的全部工作都伪装在各种商业公司和机构的掩护之下，如道胜银行（Dalbank）、莫斯科银行、贸易代表团、苏商海运公司（Sovtorgflot）、联合石油托拉斯、菲律宾烟草公司——这些实际上都是共产国际的机构。
得益于这些共产国际机构的存在，苏联特工的颠覆活动组织严密，其活动成果已显而易见。
我们看到，在南京军队后方作战的红军直接得到来自上海的支持。
菲律宾烟草公司以商业活动为掩护，促进菲律宾群岛的共产主义活动。最近在博霍尔（Bohol (?)）岛（距马尼拉不远）发生的骚乱，就是该公司“商业”活动的结果。
在上海华人中的工作尤为活跃且组织严密。学生和工人的示威游行在此频繁发生。有时参与此类示威的人数之多，以致南京路的交通陷入瘫痪。参与者分发共产主义传单并捣毁外国商行。
所有红色活动的痕迹都无形地指向阿斯托路（Astor Road）上苏联领事馆所在的房屋，指向当地世界革命准备工作的负责人博戈列波夫（Bogolepoff）同志。
目前，根据莫斯科的指示，苏联特工的直接任务是瓦解白俄移民。为此，利用了一切手段、一切可能性和所有关系。青年俄罗斯党（Mladorossy）的腐败报刊任由苏联特工支配。青年俄罗斯党的成员，如卡扎尔斯基（Kazarsky）、德罗诺夫（Dronov），与“东方宣传秘书处”有着密切联系。青年俄罗斯党的报刊对移民的道德产生了瓦解作用。
俄罗斯志愿支队，由于疏忽

page_data.en:
-3-
of its Commanding officer, Major Ivanov, has become a red
nest.
Volunteers are not allowed to become members of white
organizations; there were cases when volunteers left for
Vladivostock.
Formerly the pride of Russian Shanghai, this detachment
has now become its shame. The red influence is telling.
Brawls and drinking constitute the pass-time of volunteers
when off duty. The British police have forbidden Russian
volunteers to appear in certain districts of the Settlement.
Russian Shanghai is experiencing hard times.
Russian emigres must rescue themselves from the
Ladorossy traps skillfully set for them by the Komintern.

B. Semenoff.
page_data.zh:
-3-
其指挥官伊万诺夫（Ivanov）少校，已变成红色巢穴。
志愿者不被允许加入白人组织；曾有志愿者前往海参崴的案例。
这支曾是上海俄罗斯人骄傲的支队，如今已成为其耻辱。红色影响正在显现。斗殴和酗酒构成了志愿者下班后的消遣。英国警察已禁止俄罗斯志愿者出现在租界的某些区域。
上海俄罗斯人正经历艰难时期。
俄罗斯移民必须将自己从共产国际为它们巧妙设下的青年俄罗斯党陷阱中解救出来。

B. Semenoff.
